consequence.statement: When upgrading from Strimzi 0.34 or older with the Kafka operand, the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate must be enabled and StrimziPodSet resources must be in use before the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, enable the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate and confirm that the Kafka clusters use StrimziPodSet resources.

assertion.statement: Before upgrading Strimzi 0.34 or older to 0.46.0, operators running the Kafka operand must enable the UseStrimziPodSets feature gate and make sure StrimziPodSet resources are in use.
